meta.title: Nil Dental Studio
meta.description: Calm, unhurried dental care. Browse treatments and book your visit online.

hero.title: Unhurried dental care, in a room that feels calm.
hero.lead: Choose a treatment, pick a time that suits you and pay securely online. We explain every step before we begin.
hero.imageAlt: Placeholder image of a bright, quiet treatment room

services.title: Care for every stage, from check-ups to implants
services.lead: Every price below is the starting price of the visit. If your treatment needs more, we tell you before we continue.

checkup.name: Check-up and consultation
checkup.description: A full examination, a clear explanation of what we see and a plan you can take home.

hygiene.name: Hygiene and cleaning
hygiene.description: Scaling, polishing and practical advice to keep your gums healthy between visits.

fillings.name: Fillings
fillings.description: Tooth-coloured fillings that restore strength and blend with your natural teeth.

whitening.name: Teeth whitening
whitening.description: Gentle in-clinic whitening, planned around your sensitivity and the result you want.

implants.name: Implant consultation
implants.description: An unhurried assessment of whether implants suit you, with costs and timings in writing.

emergency.name: Urgent appointment
emergency.description: Toothache, a broken tooth or swelling. We keep time free every day for urgent care.

items.title: Choose your treatment
items.body: See what each visit includes, how long it takes and what it costs.

items.title: Pick a time and pay
items.body: Choose a free slot and pay securely online. Your confirmation arrives straight away.

items.title: Come in and relax
items.body: Arrive a few minutes early. We talk you through everything before any treatment starts.

items.title: Leave with a plan
items.body: You go home with clear aftercare advice and, if needed, a suggested next visit.

trust.title: Care you can understand and rely on
trust.lead: We want every patient to feel informed and at ease, whether it is a routine check-up or your first visit in years.
trust.imageAlt: Placeholder image of the clinic's calm waiting area

items.title: Clear, fixed prices
items.body: You see the price before you book, and nothing is added without your agreement.

items.title: Strict hygiene standards
items.body: Instruments are sterilised for every patient, and single-use items are used wherever possible.

items.title: Time to ask questions
items.body: Appointments are planned with room to talk, so nobody feels rushed in the chair.

items.title: Your data stays private
items.body: We collect only what your visit needs and handle it under GDPR.

visit.title: Opening hours and location
visit.hoursNote: Urgent appointments are available every day we are open.
visit.directions: Five minutes on foot from the nearest metro station, with step-free access at the entrance.
visit.mapAlt: Placeholder map showing the clinic's location
